title: Input symbol in a paired encoding
statement: For all natural numbers $n,k$ and Boolean words $u,w$, the symbol at one-based input position $k+1$ in the encoding of the pair whose first component is $n$ copies of $1$ and whose second component encodes $(u,w)$ equals the symbol at zero-based position $k$ in the concatenation of $2n$ copies of $1$, the separator $01$, the doubled word $u$, another separator $01$, and $w$.
